extracted.name: Mama's Balsamic Vinaigrette
extracted.description: This sweet, rich balsamic dressing can be used on green salads, over vegetables, or as a marinade for chicken.
ingredient_lines: 1 clove garlic, crushed or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Combine oil, vinegar, garlic, dijon, oregano, salt, and pepper in a jar with a tight-fitting lid. Seal the jar and shake well.
